answer: Sponsored admission with decaying reputation stops a tide of fakes. A newcomer joins only if a sponsor locks a 50-unit deposit; its score starts at 100 and decays 5% per epoch unless work refreshes it. One bad clone slashes the deposit and taints the grove, a canyon between honest networks and farms. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 50,000, but decay wipes them in 20 epochs; their rewards stay under 2,000. Honest agents pay once and keep their share.
